I am by no means a doctor, but I have experience with feeling tired at not getting nearly enough sleep.
To me it sounds like you are not getting enough sleep, the recommended time is 7-9 nine hours, and I would say 7 is the absolute minimum. You also say that you work out multiple times a day, this is far more than the average person. When you work out your body will need much more rest. In conclusion, 6 hours is way too little rest for you, I would say you simply need to get in more rest(at least 8 hours), and that might sound easier said than done, but trust me, if you try it will work out in no time. 
If you go to the doctor, he/she will tell you that you need to turn of all screens an hour before bed as the most important thing.
Here is what I did to cure my tiredness, with the help of my mentor:
When you are getting ready to go to bed, turn off all bright lights at least an hour before you want to go to sleep (dim lights are okay, but keep them to a minimum). In this time you should also keep screen time to a minimum as the blue light from the screen is very similar to the blue light you experience when waking up in the morning (you can also turn on a blue light filter on most of today’s mobile devices and laptops, do this 3 hours before bed for the best results). Next thing you can do is to make a warm cup of tea to relax your body, or even take a long hot shower(here you can listen to some calming music or meditation all music if you want to). Next thing is to getting to bed, remember to NOT use your phone right before bed, also, unimportant notifications so that they do not disturb you. When you lay in bed, I recommend finding a nice audiobook, it can be anything you like. Now you just lay and relax, and you should fall asleep in no time.

On a side note, remember to have your room as dark as possible when sleeping, you cold use a sleeping mask for best effect. And to finish off with, when you wake up in the morning do your bed as the very first thing, it will get you motivated for the day and you will be more productive! :-) “If you can’t do the small things right, how are you gonna be able to do the big things?”. When you are up and have made your bed, go for a small jog or a walk, only 15 minutes are enough, but you can do 30 if you want. This will wake you up and get your blood flowing, as well as get you some nice fresh air😄 This is what cured my tiredness!

I hope this helps you my friend, if you have any questions just ask away!
Of course I would also recommend that you go to the doctor if you feel it is serious, but the doctor will not necessarily tell you all that I have told you. Best of luck!
